assembly.name: Engine — intake & boost (IS38, manifold w/ flaps)
assembly.description: The air/boost path (dossier §2): airbox → IHI IS38 turbo with motorised wastegate → front-mount intercooler → throttle body → the plastic variable-runner intake manifold (06L133201FP) with its V157 flap motor and G336 position sensor — the assembly behind the P2015 fault this project set out to explain. Select the manifold, flaps, V157 or G336 and use the flap/fault controls in the panel.

parts.name: Air filter box & intake tract
parts.description: Airbox feeding the turbo inlet. Gen 3 runs a MAP/speed-density load model with intake-air-temp/pressure sensing rather than a traditional MAF on most trims (dossier §2).

parts.name: Turbocharger, IHI IS38
parts.description: Single-scroll, internally-wastegated IS38 integrated with the head's exhaust manifold; peak boost ~1.2 bar (dossier §2). Turbine 47.4/54.7 mm 8-blade; compressor 45.2/58.0 mm 6+6-blade. O2 sensor directly upstream of the turbine.
knownIssues: Shaft/bearing wear and wastegate-actuator faults are the documented IS38 weak points; upgraded ball-bearing replacements are common (dossier §2)

parts.name: Wastegate actuator (motorised, position feedback)
parts.description: The ECU drives wastegate position directly via this motorised actuator with position feedback (06K145xxx family, dossier §2). On replacement the ECU must re-calibrate the actuator or it throws a wastegate fault — exact variant number not in the dossier.

parts.name: Diverter valve (electric, recirculating)
parts.description: Electric recirculating diverter valve on the compressor housing — vents boost back to the inlet on throttle lift (dossier §2).

parts.name: Charge pipe, hot side (turbo → intercooler)
parts.description: Boost plumbing from the compressor outlet to the intercooler's left end tank (dossier §2 charge-air path: hard pipes, silicone couplers, clamps).

parts.name: Intercooler, front-mount air-to-air
parts.description: Front-mount air-to-air intercooler in the MQB cooling stack (dossier §2, §8): core, end tanks, and stub connections modelled; sits ahead of the radiator in the real car.

parts.name: Charge pipe, cold side (intercooler → throttle)
parts.description: Cooled charge air from the intercooler's right end tank up to the throttle body.

parts.name: Throttle body (electronic)
parts.description: Electronic throttle on the plenum inlet. Dossier §2: throttle-body T30 bolts torque ~7 Nm.

parts.name: Intake manifold with runner flaps (06L133201FP)
parts.description: Plastic manifold with integrated variable runner flaps. 06L133201FP is the current genuine complete assembly (supersedes 06L133201T → EM → FA → CM; original CJXC fitment 06L133201AH) and includes the V157 flap motor — the motor/linkage is NOT sold separately, which is why a worn flap arm means a complete manifold (dossier §2). Manifold-to-head T30 bolts ~9 Nm.
knownIssues: P2015 flap-position faults: the Gen 3 manifold is a revised, less-failure-prone design than Gen 1–2 but not immune (dossier §2). See the fault demo on this part.

parts.name: Runner flaps & shaft (tumble flaps) ×4 on common shaft
parts.description: Four butterfly flaps on a common shaft inside the runners, swung by the V157 motor: ~0% at idle to ~99% actuated (VCDS measuring block 142 tracks specified vs actual). Only supplied as part of the complete manifold. Use the flap controls in this panel to cycle them — and the P2015 toggle to jam them.
knownIssues: A worn/detached flap arm is one of the two classic P2015 roots — fix is the complete manifold 06L133201FP (dossier §2)

parts.name: Intake manifold flap motor V157
parts.description: The electric actuator (VW component code V157) that swings the runner-flap shaft. NOT available separately — only as part of the complete 06L133201FP manifold (dossier §2). Ross-Tech lists 'V157 stuck/faulty' among P2015's possible causes; VCDS Output Test [03] commands it directly to prove the linkage moves.
knownIssues: If Output Test [03] shows no flap movement, V157/linkage is implicated → complete manifold replacement

parts.name: Flap position sensor G336 (06K907386D)
parts.description: The G336 position sensor on the passenger side of the manifold — available SEPARATELY as 06K907386D (previous revision 06K907386B), which is why a pure sensor fault is the cheap fix (dossier §2). Healthy readings: ~5 V ref; signal ~4.5 V closed → ~1.2 V open; below ~0.4 V indicates over-travel past the stop.
knownIssues: Implausible G336 signal with an intact linkage → replace the sensor alone (06K907386D), then re-run Group 142 basic settings (dossier §2)

parts.name: Manifold-to-head bolts (T30) ×5
parts.description: T30 bolts fixing the manifold flange to the head. Dossier §2: intake-manifold-to-head T30 bolts torque to ~9 Nm.
